scripts.build:electron: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const buildDir=path.resolve(__dirname,'dist-electron-build');fs.rmSync(buildDir,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(buildDir,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(path.resolve(__dirname,'dist'),buildDir,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(path.resolve(__dirname,'../electron/main.js'),path.resolve(buildDir,'main.js'));fs.cpSync(path.resolve(__dirname,'../electron/preload.js'),path.resolve(buildDir,'preload.js'));fs.cpSync(path.resolve(__dirname,'../electron/icons'),path.resolve(buildDir,'icons'),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname,'electron-builder.config.yml'),path.resolve(buildDir,'electron-builder.config.yml'));const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname,'package.json'),'utf8'));delete pkg.scripts;delete pkg.devDependencies;delete pkg.build;pkg.main='main.js';pkg.devDependencies={...pkg.devDependencies,'electron':'43.4.1'};fs.writeFileSync(path.resolve(buildDir,'package.json'),JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2));console.log('Created build directory at',buildDir)"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron
